note: Chippewa NF campground on the west shore of Seelye Bay of Cut Foot Sioux Lake, about 20 mi north of Deer River via MN-46 and Eagle Nest Road (FR 2198), across the bay from East Seelye Bay. As of November 2026 the Forest Service no longer lists it on its recreation pages or on recreation.gov, so its operating status is unconfirmed. --Claude
summary: No official page left: the old FS recarea link redirects to the forest index, the forest's recreation listing and recreation.gov carry only East Seelye Bay, and a 2025 'West Seelye campground temporarily open' alert URL is now 404 (not archived). No groups written; status for the reviewer; note rewritten to drop the aggregator figures and add the dated caveat.
flags: STATUS / CRITERIA (reviewer): the Forest Service no longer publishes West Seelye Bay. The stored website redirects to the Chippewa NF recreation index; the full listing (CAMPGROUND 17 and every other type, 7 pages) has East Seelye Bay Campground and East Seelye Bay Boat Area but no West Seelye Bay; recreation.gov has no record. A search result titled 'west seelye campground temporarily open' (fs.usda.gov/r09/chippewa/alerts/...) suggests it opened only temporarily in 2025, but that page is 404 and unarchived, so its content is unread. Per 'add with a caveat, don't withhold' the entry is kept with a dated caveat; a call to the Deer River Ranger District (218-246-2123) would settle it.

SITES max_rig_ft 70 and count 22 (both derived from a note built on Campendium/camping-usa) have no official source left; consider clearing max_rig_ft 70 (the 'accommodates vehicles up to ~70 ft' line is aggregator text). Season year_round false (from 'closes after July 4 weekend', also unsourced) left.
WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: the pin sits on the wooded west shore of Seelye Bay under continuous canopy; no loop or pads resolve on Esri imagery and no site data exists.
PIN 47.52400,-94.10050 left (no official point to compare; ~380 m across the bay from East Seelye Bay 5468, a separate campground reached by its own road).

Suggest the Deer River district's East Seelye Bay page is NOT a substitute. PHONE 218-335-8600 (forest-wide number) -> 218-246-2123 (Deer River Ranger District, which runs East Seelye Bay next door) if a district number is wanted.
